Designed with contractors in mind, these mounting brackets streamline cable routing, reduce clutter, and provide long‑lasting cable support‑all while making installations faster and easier.Each bracket features a sturdy 1.4" ABS plastic mounting tab engineered for strength and reliability. This rugged design withstands demanding jobsite conditions and activity of other trades during construction, preventing damage or dislodgement. Built to last, the ABS material maintains its durability without cracking or warping, ensuring cables remain neatly secured from the rough‑in through final installation.The flexible pass‑through wing allows for versatile cable management, accommodating a wide variety of cable types while keeping them neatly organized. Whether running data, audio, video, or other low‑voltage lines, the smooth edges of the wing protect the cables from nicks, abrasions, or pinching‑helping preserve signal integrity and extending the life of the wiring. This thoughtful design makes the brackets ideal for structured wiring, home theater setups, and commercial network installations.One standout feature of the Cable Clip Mounting Brackets is their bright yellow color. This highly visible finish makes them easy to locate during construction, reducing the chance of accidental cuts, breaks, or misplacement by contractors or subcontractors. The vibrant color also assists inspectors and project managers in quickly identifying cable routing points, further enhancing jobsite efficiency.Installation is quick and straightforward, making the Cable Clip Mounting Brackets a preferred choice among professional installers. With simple mounting capabilities, contractors can save time on large‑scale projects while still delivering a clean, organized result. Sold in a convenient 50‑pack, these brackets provide excellent value‑ensuring installers have enough on hand for multiple runs and large installations without delay.Ideal for structured cabling, smart home systems, AV setups, or office network wiring, the Cable Clip Mounting Brackets combine strength, flexibility, and visibility to deliver a superior cable management solution.
